build_md_gender_dataset: run the build function to download and set up the md_gender dataset for ParlAI
download_md_gender_resources: download the gend_multiclass dataset archive from parl.ai into the specified data path
check_md_gender_version: check if the md_gender dataset is already built at the expected version v1.0
remove_outdated_md_gender_data: remove an older version of the md_gender dataset directory before rebuilding
review_build_function: review the build function to understand how md_gender data is downloaded and versioned
